````text
        self.assertIn('class="mermaid"', (self.root / "site/guides/setup/index.html").read_text())
        self.assertIn("flowchart TD", (self.root / "site/guides/setup/index.md").read_text())
        checker = [sys.executable, "-I", str(self.root / "scripts/check-docs-site.py"),
                   "--target-dir", str(self.root)]
        result = subprocess.run(checker, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout)["llm_pages"], 2)
        search = self.root / "site/search.json"
        original_search = search.read_text()
        invalid_search = json.loads(original_search)
        for items in ([], "not-an-index"):
            invalid_search["items"] = items
            search.write_text(json.dumps(invalid_search))
            self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(checker, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)
        search.write_text(original_search)
        llms = self.root / "site/llms.txt"
        original = llms.read_text()
        llms.write_text("# Empty\n")
        self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(checker, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)
        llms.write_text(original)
        llms.write_text(original.replace("https://example.test/project/", "https://example.test/"))
        self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(checker, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)
        llms.write_text(original)
        markdown = self.root / "site/guides/setup/index.md"
        markdown.unlink()
        self.assertNotEqual(subprocess.run(checker, capture_output=True).returncode, 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

After reviewing the plan and obtaining consent, repeat without `--dry-run`.
`--ci` adds a **build-only** workflow; omitting it creates no workflow.
For a reviewed nonempty `docs/`, add `--existing keep`. It requires an existing
`docs/index.md` and preserves the whole tree; it does not reorganize content.

The initializer refuses existing MkDocs/Zensical config, symlinks, and collisions
with generated paths. There is no `--force` mode. Re-running on a configured
project stops without changes: switch to maintenance instead.

### 3. Add development-only dependencies and build

Existing `pyproject.toml` is left untouched; follow the initializer's JSON
`next_steps` after reviewing the proposed dependency group:

```bash
uv add --group docs 'zensical==0.0.73'
uv sync --locked --only-group docs
uv run --no-sync zensical build --strict
uv run --no-sync python scripts/check-docs-site.py
```

A docs-only project without a prior `pyproject.toml` receives a non-packaged uv
project with Python >=3.11 and a docs group; run `uv lock` first instead of `uv add`.
Keep `uv.lock` under version control. Inspect its diff: do not silently upgrade
unrelated dependencies or replace an existing package index.

`--only-group docs` is suitable for CI. For local work that also needs the
application/dev dependencies, use `uv sync --locked --group docs` instead.
Do not put Zensical in `[project].dependencies` merely to make a build work.

The project-local checker verifies root and nested pages, full text, Markdown
counterparts, Copy as Markdown targets, project-subpath links, and a nonempty
search artifact. Fix failures instead of dropping strict mode. Its contract is
all `docs/**/*.md` pages; custom exclusions, output layouts, or plugins require
reviewing and adapting the checker as part of the same change.

### 4. Maintain project-owned documentation

Add English `.md` pages under `docs/` and keep relative links correct. The
initial config uses automatic navigation and llmstxt globs for root and nested
pages; no separate page helper is needed. If the user wants an explicit `nav`,
maintain it alongside the pages. Do not create locale-suffixed placeholders.

Preserve the README as a useful repository entrypoint. Link it to `docs/index.md`
until a site is actually published; a future `site_url` is not a live website.
Add commands to the project's existing Makefile/Justfile rather than replacing
its task runner. Run its normal checks as well as the documentation checks.

For preview:

```bash
uv run --no-sync zensical serve --dev-addr 127.0.0.1:8000
# If that port is occupied, choose another without stopping the existing service:
uv run --no-sync zensical serve --dev-addr 127.0.0.1:8769
```

Expose the address in the project's task runner instead of hard-coding port 8000.
For Just, use an optional port followed by an optional host:

```just
docs-serve port="8000" host="127.0.0.1":
    uv run --locked --group docs zensical serve --dev-addr "{{host}}:{{port}}"
```

`just docs-serve 8769` stays on loopback. A host such as `0.0.0.0` exposes the
preview to other machines; use it only when sharing is intentional.

The template enables Mermaid fences through `pymdownx.superfences.custom_fences`.
For process diagrams, keep node/edge labels explicit and supply a text equivalent.
# Created by zensical-site-bootstrap; project-owned after initialization.
[project]
site_name = {{SITE_NAME}}
site_url = {{SITE_URL}}
repo_url = {{REPO_URL}}
edit_uri = "edit/main/docs/"
docs_dir = "docs"
site_dir = "site"

[project.theme]
language = "en"
features = [
  "content.action.edit",
  "content.action.copy",
  "content.code.copy",
  "navigation.footer",
  "navigation.sections",
  "navigation.top",
  "search.highlight",
]

[[project.theme.palette]]
scheme = "default"
toggle.icon = "lucide/sun"
toggle.name = "Switch to dark mode"

[[project.theme.palette]]
scheme = "slate"
toggle.icon = "lucide/moon"
toggle.name = "Switch to light mode"

[project.markdown_extensions]
admonition = {}
attr_list = {}
toc.permalink = true
pymdownx.details = {}
pymdownx.highlight.pygments_lang_class = true
pymdownx.superfences.custom_fences = [
  { name = "mermaid", class = "mermaid", format = "pymdownx.superfences.fence_code_format" },
]
pymdownx.tabbed.alternate_style = true

[project.plugins.llmstxt]
full_output = "llms-full.txt"

[project.plugins.llmstxt.sections]
# **/*.md alone omits root pages in the tested Zensical release.
Documentation = ["*.md", "**/*.md"]
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check the English all-pages artifact contract; never build or publish the site."""

import argparse
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import tomllib
from urllib.parse import unquote, urljoin, urlsplit


class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, text):
        super().__init__()
        self.copy_urls = []
        self.links = []
        self.feed(text)

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        attrs = dict(attrs)
        if "data-md-copy-url" in attrs:
            self.copy_urls.append(attrs["data-md-copy-url"])
        if tag == "a" and attrs.get("href"):
            self.links.append(attrs["href"])
        if tag == "img" and attrs.get("src"):
            self.links.append(attrs["src"])


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(root):
    project = tomllib.loads((root / "zensical.toml").read_text())["project"]
    require(project.get("docs_dir", "docs") == "docs" and project.get("site_dir", "site") == "site",
            "this checker expects docs/ and site/; review it before changing output layout")
    require(project.get("theme", {}).get("language") == "en", "this pilot validates English content only")
    require(not project.get("hooks"), "MkDocs hooks are not supported by this pilot")
    plugins = project.get("plugins", {})
    require(not (set(plugins) - {"search", "llmstxt"}),
            "additional plugins need an explicit compatibility and artifact review")
    require(plugins.get("llmstxt", {}).get("full_output") == "llms-full.txt",
            "expected llmstxt.full_output = llms-full.txt")
    base = project["site_url"]
    require(base.endswith("/"), "site_url must end in /")
    origin = urlsplit(base)
    docs, site = root / "docs", root / "site"
    for directory in (docs, site):
        require(directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink(), f"missing or symlinked {directory.name}/")
        require(not any(path.is_symlink() for path in directory.rglob("*")),
                f"{directory.name}/ contains symlinks")
    sources = sorted(docs.rglob("*.md"))
    require(sources and (docs / "index.md") in sources, "expected docs/index.md and Markdown pages")

    def local_file(url):
        parsed = urlsplit(url)
        require((parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc) == (origin.scheme, origin.netloc),
                f"artifact URL uses a different origin: {url}")
        require(parsed.path.startswith(origin.path), f"artifact URL drops the project subpath: {url}")
        relative = unquote(parsed.path[len(origin.path):])
        path = (site / relative).resolve()
        require(path.is_relative_to(site.resolve()), f"artifact URL escapes site/: {url}")
        if parsed.path.endswith("/"):
            path /= "index.html"
        require(path.is_file(), f"missing artifact for {url}")
        return path

    index = (site / "llms.txt").read_text()
    full = (site / "llms-full.txt").read_text()
    links = re.findall(r"^\s*-\s+\[.*?\]\(<?([^)>\s]+)>?\)", index, re.MULTILINE)
    exported = [local_file(link) for link in links]
    require(len(exported) == len(set(exported)), "duplicate pages in llms.txt")
    expected = set()
    for source in sources:
        relative = source.relative_to(docs)
        directory = relative.parent if relative.name == "index.md" else relative.with_suffix("")
        markdown = site / directory / "index.md"
        html = site / directory / "index.html"
        expected.add(markdown.resolve())
        require(markdown.is_file() and html.is_file(), f"missing HTML/Markdown pair for {relative}")
        content = markdown.read_text().strip()
        require(content and content in full, f"full output omits content from {relative}")
        page = Page(html.read_text())
        html_url = urljoin(base, html.relative_to(site).as_posix())
        require(page.copy_urls, f"missing Copy as Markdown button for {relative}")
        for url in page.copy_urls:
            require(local_file(urljoin(html_url, url)) == markdown.resolve(),
                    f"copy button selects the wrong source for {relative}")
        for href in page.links:
            if href.startswith("#"):
                continue
            url = urljoin(html_url, href)
            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            if (parsed.scheme, parsed.netloc) == (origin.scheme, origin.netloc):
                local_file(url)
    require(set(exported) == expected, "llms.txt does not cover exactly the intended Markdown pages")
    search = json.loads((site / "search.json").read_text())
    require(isinstance(search, dict) and isinstance(search.get("items"), list)
            and bool(search["items"]), "empty or invalid search index: expected nonempty items")
    return {"status": "ok", "pages": len(sources), "llm_pages": len(exported), "deployed": False}


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--target-dir", default=".", help="Project root containing zensical.toml")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        result = check(Path(args.target_dir).resolve())
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        print(json.dumps({"status": "failed", "deployed": False}))
        return 1
    print(json.dumps(result))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

release date has been announced. Treat these as pre-release design statements,
not a guarantee that the final design cannot change.

`mkdocs-llmstxt`, `mkdocs-static-i18n`, and `mkdocs-copy-to-llm` depend on the
MkDocs plugin lifecycle. **PyMdown's snippets, superfences, and tabs are Python
Markdown extensions, not MkDocs plugins**; assess Markdown compatibility
separately rather than claiming every extension has the same failure mode.

Do not upgrade this Material-based stack to MkDocs 2.0 without a separately
validated migration. There is no need to adopt a different hosting provider:
GitHub Actions can build the static output before GitHub Pages serves it.

## What Zensical supports now

The latest release at verification was
[0.0.73 (2026-10-26)](https://github.com/zensical/zensical/releases/tag/v0.0.73).
[0.0.67 (2026-09-30)](https://github.com/zensical/zensical/releases/tag/v0.0.67)
added native `llmstxt` and a Copy as Markdown button. The old assessment that
there was no published support for these functions is obsolete.

The [plugin compatibility table](https://zensical.org/docs/compatibility/mkdocs/plugins/)
is the authority for individual settings, not the presence of a plugin name in
`mkdocs.yml`:

| Requirement | Upstream status and limits |
|---|---|
| Existing `mkdocs.yml` / Material look | Supported migration path; `theme.variant: classic` preserves the familiar appearance. Custom template overrides may need changes. |
| Search / Python API reference | Native search and `mkdocstrings` integration are documented. Install the required handler; audit companion plugins separately. |
| `llms.txt`, full output, Markdown counterparts | Native `llmstxt` since 0.0.67. Validate sections, exported content, and project Pages subpaths. Custom Python `preprocess` is ignored. |
| Copy as Markdown | `content.action.copy` works for pages with Markdown counterparts. This is not proof of parity with every `mkdocs-copy-to-llm` button or custom asset. |
| UI language / alternate-language links | Documented, but not proof of suffix content translation, fallback, contextual switching, translated nav, or per-language search. |
````

````text
# Playwright times out on Mermaid SVG even though the Zensical diagram is visible

## Symptom

With Zensical 0.0.73, both `pre.mermaid svg` and `.mermaid svg` timed out in
Playwright. The visible host serialized as `<div class="mermaid"></div>` and
`element.shadowRoot` returned `null`, despite a rendered diagram and nonzero height.

## Root cause

The native Mermaid integration replaces the source block with a host using a
**closed shadow root**. A Chromium DevTools Protocol inspection confirmed
`shadowRootType: "closed"`. Ordinary DOM selectors, including Playwright's
open-shadow traversal, cannot inspect its SVG descendants.

----
# Zensical says "No issues found" but llms.txt contains only headings

## Symptom

With Zensical 0.0.73, `zensical build --strict` prints:

```text
Build started
No issues found
Build finished in 0.45s
```

But `llms.txt` contains only the site and section headings, and root source
pages have no exported Markdown counterparts or Copy as Markdown buttons.

----

[Canonical skill and helpers](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/agent-skills/tree/main/skills/local/zensical-site-bootstrap)

## What it provides

- Explicit-target dry runs and refusal to overwrite existing site configurations.
- Optional preservation of a reviewed `docs/` tree, without reorganizing content.
- Zensical 0.0.73 in a docs dependency group, not application runtime dependencies.
- Native `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, Markdown exports, and Copy as Markdown.
- Mermaid fences and preview commands with configurable host/port.
- A project-owned checker for content coverage, copy targets, and Pages subpaths.
- Optional GitHub Actions build checks with no deployment permissions.
44:The latest release at verification was
58:| `llms.txt`, full output, Markdown counterparts | Native `llmstxt` since 0.0.67. Validate sections, exported content, and project Pages subpaths. Custom Python `preprocess` is ignored. |
````
